question: By whom and concerning which beings was something told to the beloved one?
premises: Something was told concerning the earth-movers and the good-eaters.
It was told by an earth-mover.
It was told to the beloved one.
inference: An earth-mover told to the beloved one what concerns the earth-movers and the good-eaters.
uncertainties: The content told is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: By an earth-mover, what concerns the earth-movers and the good-eaters was told, O beloved one.
